title: Use memcpy in endian read/write function for native endianness

target.summary: On big-endian hosts (RZ_HOST_IS_BIG_ENDIAN), using memcpy to read or write ut128 values swaps the high and low 64-bit halves because the ut128 struct layout places Low before High in memory. This causes big-endian 128-bit read and write operations to produce incorrect values.
